questions.title: 你希望被什么样的光笼罩？

options.text: 透过树叶缝隙的、跳动的晨光
options.visual: dappled morning sunlight filtering through leaves, warm golden green tones, hopeful atmosphere

options.text: 清冷的、让万物轮廓清晰的月光
options.visual: cold moonlight casting sharp shadows, silver and blue tones, quiet introspective atmosphere

options.text: 温暖如拥抱的、将影子拉长的暮光
options.visual: warm golden hour sunset light, long dramatic shadows, nostalgic peaceful atmosphere

options.text: 五颜六色的、来自霓虹招牌的迷幻光
options.visual: vibrant neon lights in electric blue and magenta, cyberpunk aesthetic, energetic atmosphere

questions.title: 你脚下是什么样的大地？

options.text: 被薄雾缠绕的古老森林小径
options.visual: a winding path through a misty ancient forest, towering twisted trees, moss-covered stones

options.text: 雨后倒映着霓虹的湿润城市街道
options.visual: wet city street reflecting neon signs after rain, puddles mirroring the lights

options.text: 开满不知名野花的、一望无际的草原
options.visual: endless grassland covered in unknown wildflowers, gentle breeze, vast open sky

options.text: 漂浮在云海之上的破碎浮空岛
options.visual: floating islands above a sea of clouds, ancient crumbling ruins on the islands, magical

questions.title: 你的背包里，最重要的那件东西是什么？

options.text: 一本祖传的、密密麻麻写满笔记的旧书
options.visual: clutching an ancient leather-bound book filled with handwritten notes and mystical runes

options.text: 一封从未寄出的、用火漆封缄的信
options.visual: holding a sealed letter with a red wax seal, tied with a faded silk ribbon

options.text: 一把简单但被磨得锃亮的工具刀
options.visual: a simple but well-worn practical knife at the belt, handle polished from years of use

options.text: 一颗偶尔会自己发光的、温热的石头
options.visual: a small warm stone glowing softly with inner light, cupped gently in both hands

questions.title: 你最想遇到什么样的同伴？

options.text: 一只会说话、嘴贱但忠诚的猫
options.visual: a small sarcastic black cat companion with gleaming intelligent eyes, perched on the shoulder

options.text: 一个沉默寡言但永远靠得住的旅人
options.visual: a tall silent companion in a worn cloak, standing protectively nearby, dependable presence

options.text: 一个迷路的、需要你保护的笨拙小精灵
options.visual: a tiny lost clumsy forest spirit with translucent wings, looking up with trusting eyes

options.text: 没有同伴，但你能听见风中传来的古老低语
options.visual: standing alone, wind swirling around, faint ancient runes visible in the air currents

questions.title: 这个世界正面临什么样的困境？

options.text: 人们的色彩正在慢慢褪去，世界在变灰
options.visual: the edges of the world fading to monochrome grey, but the main subject still retains vibrant color

options.text: 一种让人忘记梦境的迷雾正在蔓延
options.visual: a creeping fog that erases dreams, dreamlike fragments floating just out of reach in the mist

options.text: 连接各个浮空岛的古老桥梁正在断裂
options.visual: crumbling ancient stone bridges between floating islands, the gaps widening, urgency in the air

options.text: 不是困境，这是一个刚诞生的、等待被命名的新世界
options.visual: a pristine newborn world, blank canvas-like, full of potential and wonder, creator's energy

questions.title: 这个世界以何种形状呈现？

options.text: 正方形——像一枚专属徽章
options.compose_hint: centered composition, balanced, iconic, like a personal emblem

options.text: 竖长形——像一张人物立绘
options.compose_hint: tall vertical composition, full-body character focus, portrait-style

options.text: 横长形——像电影的一个定格画面
options.compose_hint: wide cinematic horizontal composition, environmental storytelling, movie still

options.text: 不规则的碎片形——像一块记忆的碎片
options.compose_hint: fragmented composition, dreamlike, edges fading into darkness, like a memory shard

questions.title: 给这个世界起一个名字吧。
questions.placeholder: 比如：回声之境、星落之森...（留空则由我们命名）
